title: Implement Decapod-owned slices for Issues #1222, #1223, and #1224
intent: Implement only the Decapod-owned storage seams that are stable before dactyl: backend-neutral contention/retry classification, caller-owned explicit IDs with affected-row writes, and migration planning/applied-ledger orchestration. Keep physical schema execution and dactyl error conversion deferred until dactyl's pure-Rust contract is available.
stop_conditions: Stop before implementing backend-specific schema execution or dactyl code; leave those issue scopes open for the dactyl migration.
